title: Machine learning maps adenylate-forming enzymes and finds a Nocardia beta-lactone pathway
summary: A machine-learning classifier predicted adenylate-forming enzyme function and substrate specificity from protein sequence and was applied to more than 50,000 candidate biosynthetic gene clusters across bacterial, fungal and plant genomes. It predicted beta-lactone synthetases in uncharacterised clusters conserved in more than 90 Nocardia strains. A candidate enzyme from Nocardia brasiliensis was purified and the pathway reconstituted in vitro, linking the cluster to the beta-lactone nocardiolactone. Only one enzyme was tested experimentally.
